target_question: H1 sparse traversal vs same-local-rule dense traversal, followed by active-index reuse; 16-8-2 toy MLP only.
out_of_scope: statistically generalizable claims from five seeds

minimum_gates.blocker: Requires separately authorized synthetic data generation and per-seed hashes; cannot be closed by static review.
minimum_gates.next_evidence: Freeze generator selection and seed manifest; later audit actual unique samples, activity and leakage.

minimum_gates.blocker: Numerical equality cannot be claimed without separately authorized paired model execution.
minimum_gates.next_evidence: Predefine dtype, initialization, iteration order and trace tolerances for same-local-learning-rule contrasts.

minimum_gates.blocker: Quality floor and descriptive paired statistics need preregistration; empirical parity requires approved runs.
minimum_gates.next_evidence: Predefine per-seed paired effect and uncertainty reporting, quality failure rule and no posthoc exclusions.

minimum_gates.blocker: Software proxies exclude interpreter overhead; observed instrumentation needs execution.
minimum_gates.next_evidence: Freeze source-event boundaries, warmups, repeated timings, RSS method and observer overhead control.

minimum_gates.blocker: Calibration control and nonleakage split not yet approved.
minimum_gates.next_evidence: Preregister train-only baseline controls and calibration/test separation; no calibration runs now.

minimum_gates.blocker: First H1 CPU pilot can explicitly report NOT_MEASURED; must not claim joules.
minimum_gates.next_evidence: Freeze energy fields at NOT_MEASURED; physical energy becomes a separately reviewed later experiment.

minimum_gates.blocker: CL-8D fixed child probe is not a model runner; GitHub hosted unshare got OS_PERMISSION_DENIED.
minimum_gates.next_evidence: Design a trusted pinned no-network host and external budgets, then independently validate fixed non-model denial.

minimum_gates.blocker: Codex approval is code review, not methodological signoff.
minimum_gates.next_evidence: Obtain genuine independent domain-scientist review with explicit construct, causal and statistical judgments.

minimum_gates.blocker: No user authorization for model inference or training has been granted.
minimum_gates.next_evidence: After all other gates, request separate approval tied to exact commit, data hash, scope and budget.

recommended_pretraining_order: Freeze H1-only claims, control arms and no-energy-measurement boundaries
Freeze selection-bias and train-only calibration/quality-parity acceptance contracts
Freeze causal equivalence and instrumented work-vs-runtime statistics
Obtain approved data provenance, safe offline host and independent scientific review
Only then request Marcus-specific approval for any proposed execution
